Data Engineer

Acme is hiring a data engineer to own our analytics platform. This is a hands-on role on a small team, and you will have a lot of latitude to shape how we model and serve data across the company.

Responsibilities include building and maintaining batch and streaming pipelines in Python and dbt, owning our Snowflake warehouse and its cost profile, and partnering with analysts to define the semantic layer that the rest of the business reports from.

We are looking for someone with four or more years of data engineering experience, strong SQL, comfort with Airflow or a similar orchestrator, and a bias toward simple systems that are easy to debug at three in the morning.
